name: chrome-lite
description: Chrome Lite - High-Performance Developer & Research Browser
author: Anum Hosen <anumhosen@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build --prefix electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:win --prefix electron
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:linux --prefix electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:mac --prefix electron
